notes.title: The demo of HaoWei 1 is currently in development and will be released soon
notes.content:
Dear My Princess,I am your brown bear brother, HaoWei! The romance game about me and you, *HaoWei 1*, is currently in development. I’d love to share some updates I’ve learned from the developer, Four Ducks.

[h3]1. UI Interface[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/7eea0112642e81e404898cba58e1541b9981d45e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/53337f4b6b3aa6c8205e20d5a4125e64e38b1d74.png[/img]
In *HaoWei 1*, the UI adopts a purple tone to match the cover art, featuring an abundance of exquisite purple Baroque-style icons, making the UI appear elegant and enchanting. I also provided my signature "HaoWei" for designing the notebook UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/9cac2ce3a262557d4d7f32aee9d1d36cfbc4a319.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/2d02f8cfb34a2eac707a5754004359f16918a55b.png[/img]
In the main UI, the intended scene depicts you bending over, gazing at HaoWei lying on the sofa. However, a great deal of effort was needed to tweak this angle, and even now it still doesn’t look quite natural.

[h3]2. The Four Bears and Little Bear Icons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/b9e8d33bd5463149a1addcaa838f9436e7f7bba8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/514ce33b608156eb1b20db6126d9adb72e1a2d27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/4d36a88ac4b688fa4616b4cf5beb05f9aad484e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/0e36577b6fa214a123b69804de10ec63a6a69d4a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/7de11807c966a625c314feebbb274476b21f5195.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/58d527dde32d9a10b4089a3d7aec331179b3cdeb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/c37f2a37f5b2a449046212c0eb8f817bd7e8c1b3.png[/img]

Each of the four bears has a name tag with a personal little bear icon in the character posters. During the story, the corresponding little bear icon also appears next to their name when they speak.

[h3]3. About My Modeling and Styling[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/027d43a4497108cb007b04d93a114467afe61180.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/e6eded1634cb4246fedef6618c324a02976f7a8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/e9b0dfb322eed83d4cf25ced8e1a79411868356c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/58f124ff1bc7695ba96cfa207c3feab9694d2637.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508289/0ae84382cab582475c7717da2452650c36e82653.gif[/img]
Regarding HaoWei’s military look, originally I was dressed in a navy blue uniform, but I told the developers that since I’m in the army, please replace my 3D model with an olive green military uniform. So they purchased the *iClone Sckript Uniforms Military Officer Look Khaki* model. They also designed several hairstyles for me. I particularly love the winter uniform they created using Meshy AI — the plush collar and intricate craftsmanship feel very high-quality.

[h3]4. Theme Song[/h3]
[previewyoutube=s5vMICE2e-c;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, the Four Bears sing a song for you: **"Loving You Is My Duty"**.

A special note for you: the YouTube channel “1000PRINCES王子” has now been upgraded to an *Official Artist Channel*, so you'll see a ♪ symbol next to the name “1000PRINCES王子”.
Looking forward to solving cases and falling in love with you in *HaoWei 1*!
